claim: Selecting a taxonomy or parent node highlights the selected node plus its recursive child subtree, including grandchildren and deeper descendants, while dimming unrelated nodes more strongly.

behavior.selectedSubtreeTraversal: Recursive over HAS_CHILD edges and reverse BELONGS_TO/PART_OF edges; direct connected nodes remain included for non-tree context.
behavior.edgeEmphasis: Edges whose source and target are both inside the selected subtree/neighborhood are emphasized.

verification.evidence: Vite build succeeded; existing vis-network chunk-size warning remains
